rationale: The original bearish entry signal — price breaking below the 9-EMA at $22.02 — has been mechanically negated; price has recovered from the intraday low (~$21.53) all the way back to $21.74, now sitting at or above the current 9-EMA ($21.73), erasing the momentum breakdown that justified the short. The last several candles display a consistent stair-step higher with increasing volume on the up legs, and the maximum favorable excursion of 0.74% has largely been surrendered with no progress toward the $20.80 target. With only 43 minutes to close and price drifting into the short's invalidation zone rather than away from it, the position's edge is gone and further holding primarily adds risk.
